description: Draft the skeleton of a Korean 내용증명 (certified-content letter) from the user's own facts: 대여금 반환 (loan), 임대차 보증금 반환 (deposit), 밀린 임금·퇴직금 (wage), 물품·용역 대금 (payment) or 임대차 갱신 거절 (nonrenewal). Unknown fields stay as ○ placeholders. Returns the text, the statute it rests on and sending tips (3 copies at the post office; 6-month follow-up under 민법 제174조). Not legal advice or document-drafting representation.

facts.description: One or two lines of facts (optional)

since.description: Cause date: lent on, lease ended, left the job, delivered, or lease expiry
